claim: Across 160 fixed schedules, at $150/kWh the continuation policy loses to three-scenario by $7.32/$3.90 per site-day under primary and $3.07/$2.54 under one-call (7/30 days). One-call seven-day sign flips near $59.16/kWh.
assumptions: Whole-path rainflow, NMC illustrative depth curve, no calibration or reoptimization, matched original services separately within each contract.
falsifier: Different cell/price/activation/dispatch assumptions can reverse the fixed-path ranking; published former cost optima are invalid under direct transfer.
